disclaimer.title: What we will never ask of you
disclaimer.text: WAHHF supports you free of charge. We do not sell visas or jobs and do not guarantee any outcome. We never ask you for money. Decisions belong solely to the relevant authorities and institutions. Always verify information on official websites.

mission.title: A human bridge between Cameroon and Germany
mission.p1: Born from a dual Cameroonian and German heritage, WAHHF Foundation (We Are Here Help Foundation) is the social and philanthropic branch of the IROKO Group.
mission.p2: Convinced that dignity comes through knowledge, health, and autonomy, we develop sustainable field programs alongside a free German language and European orientation initiative.

mobilitySpot.title: Learn German, navigate towards Europe
mobilitySpot.subtitle: Free German lessons and guidance, with no registration fees and no commercial intermediaries.
mobilitySpot.card1Desc: Structured German language course support from beginner A1 to advanced C1, with an online placement test.
mobilitySpot.card2Desc: Clear, verified 4-step guidance: understanding study, vocational training, or work pathways and preparing your file.
mobilitySpot.card3Desc: Luxembourg, Germany, Slovenia, Italy, Greece, Portugal, Spain, Denmark, Poland, and Albania.
